pool.title: Model Groups
pool.emptyText: No model groups yet. A group assembles multiple instances of the same model for failover/load balancing. Skip it if you don't need routing.
pool.routeHint: When a model request uses a group name (by convention "auto-model"), a healthy instance is automatically selected from the group. If no group is configured, auto-model falls back to all healthy instances of the service.
pool.poolNamePlaceholder: e.g. auto-model (requesting a model with this name triggers routing across the group)
pool.noInstancesTip: No instances under this model category. Add one in Instance Management first.
pool.memberWeightTip: Members reference specific model channels; weight determines the probability of being selected (ignored under the consistent-hash strategy).

strategies.ip-hash: Same IP to the same instance

strategyHints.weighted-random: Not sure? Pick this - the system distributes by weight, so instances with a higher weight are picked more often
strategyHints.round-robin: Picks one instance after another, the most even distribution
strategyHints.least-connections: Prefers the instance with the fewest active connections - useful when instance performance differs a lot
strategyHints.ip-hash: The same IP always goes to the same instance - useful when session affinity is required
strategyHints.consistent-hash: The same user always lands on the same instance, with the least impact when instances are added or removed (weight is ignored)

pool.memberEmptyHint: No member yet - pick one on the right

deleteDialog.title: Delete Confirmation
deleteDialog.message: Are you sure you want to delete model group "{name}"?
deleteDialog.impact: After deletion, applications requesting this group name (e.g. auto-model) can no longer use the routing and fall back to all healthy instances of that service.
deleteDialog.remedy: You can recreate a group with the same name and re-add its members, but the member configuration has to be filled in again.

messages.memberAlreadyAdded: This instance is already a member
messages.memberIdMigrated: Legacy member identifiers detected and auto-converted to model names ({count}). Save to apply.
messages.memberRequired: Please add at least one member
messages.saveFailed: Save failed. Please check your input

pool.memberCategoryHint: Member candidates come only from the "{category}" category of this group: pools route by category, so instances from other categories can never be reached.
